title: The Carey Treatment
writer: Michael Crichton, John D.F. Black, Harriet Frank Jr.
actors: James Coburn, Jennifer O'Neill, Pat Hingle
plot: At a Boston hospital, a new surgeon, Dr. Carey, becomes an amateur sleuth to help clear a colleague's name who's been accused of botching an illegal abortion that killed a 15 year old girl; the daughter of the chief surgeon.
